checked_sources.evidence: AFI Catalog released-film synopsis says the Terminator searches the phone directory for Sarah J. Connor and locates three Sarah Connor listings.
Opened screenplay as a secondary corroborating source; the phone-directory search appears in the script.

AFI's released-film synopsis establishes the chronology: Kyle's bomb causes the tanker explosion; the skeleton survives; the factory bomb breaks it apart; its upper half crawls toward Sarah; she crushes it in the hydraulic press, extinguishing its red eyes.
Opened screenplay corroborates the factory pipe bomb and final hydraulic-press sequence; used as secondary support, with the AFI film catalog as released-film evidence.
AFI's film synopsis says Sarah is pregnant with Kyle's son John, supporting the father/son relation and the article's framing.
Opened screenplay dialogue in the factory scene directly confirms to Kyle that John is their son.
